_comment: B51 — turns a Ghostwire matrix payload (treasure, flags.draw-steel-ghostwire.matrix.role 'payload') into a 'Run {Payload}' ability. Shape follows the Hacker's Wired abilities: keywords ranged + wired, power roll @chr over reason (the Wire rules roll Programs with Logic, which is Draw Steel's Reason), distance special (the deck's Reach). Keyed by the payload's system._dsid; an unknown payload falls back to 'generic'. Tier text lives in lang/en.json under GHOSTWIRE.PayloadUse.Payloads.<lang>.
_zapNote: Zap is the only payload that deals damage directly. Numbers are the Draw Steel echelon-1 signature ladder (2/5/7 + characteristic), untyped: biofeedback hits Stamina with no damage type.
